# Qiao Partners

> Qiao Partners helps Chinese manufacturers enter the European market: market diagnosis, go-to-market strategy, EU business development, entity, certification and tax setup. Warsaw and Beijing.

Qiao Partners is a commercial advisory firm based in Warsaw, Poland, with a presence in Beijing. It helps Chinese manufacturers enter the European market and European companies set up in China. It does not invest or give investment advice.

## Services
- Market diagnosis: Regulation, demand, competitors and pricing in your segment, with a recommended entry model. Usually 4–6 weeks.
- Market entry and go-to-market strategy: Channels, partners, pricing and a plan for your first 12 months of sales in the EU.
- EU business development and lead generation: We act as your European sales team: qualified buyers, distributors and EPC contractors, and meetings booked.
- Entity, certification and tax setup: With partner law and tax firms: company formation, CE marking and battery passport, VAT, and Polish Investment Zone incentives.
- Regulation and government relations: CBAM, the EU ETS, the Batteries Regulation and sector rules; engagement with ministries, agencies and regulators.
- China entry for European companies: Entity setup, production moves, cost estimates and market strategy in China.

## Market trends we track (to 2035)
- Battery storage (BESS) and components (Now): Poland's grid-storage build-out, and the EU battery passport from February 2027.
- Heavy-duty zero-emission vehicles (Now): Battery-electric and hydrogen trucks, buses, chargers and drivetrain parts, as EU CO₂ standards require new truck emissions to fall 45% by 2030 and 90% by 2040.
- Biomethane equipment and membranes (Now): Upgrading membranes, compressors and digesters toward the EU goal of 35 bcm of biomethane a year by 2030.
- AI data-centre components (Now): Liquid cooling, power distribution and backup power for new European capacity.
- Solar, grid and transformers (Now): Inverters, transformers and switchgear for grid expansion, under the Net-Zero Industry Act's resilience rules.
- Battery recycling equipment (2027–2030): Processing lines ahead of the EU's minimum recycled-content rules for batteries from 2031.
- Heat pumps and industrial heat (2027–2030): Electrified heat as carbon pricing reaches buildings and transport fuels through ETS2, planned from 2028.
- Hydrogen and electrolysers (2030–2035): RED III requires 42% renewable hydrogen in industry by 2030 and 60% by 2035.
- Sodium-ion and long-duration storage (2030–2035): Next-generation storage chemistries as grids need many hours of flexibility.
